title: What happened in AI — Jul 13, 2026
intro: Today's feed skews toward tooling for people who run coding agents day to day: control planes, browser-vision plugins, financial-data feeds, and attention trackers for juggling multiple agents at once, mostly from indie builders on Show HN.

The production-scale counterpart came from bigger platforms: DoorDash detailed a multi-agent shopping assistant with persistent memory, Google Cloud shipped AI bill-of-materials scanning for GKE, and Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 beat Hebbia's own finance-tuned models on Hebbia's internal evals.
highlights: Today's Show HN crop skews toward coding-agent tooling — control planes, browser vision, financial data feeds, and multi-agent attention tracking — plus an open P2P protocol for agent-to-agent coordination.
DoorDash's Ask DoorDash assistant combines an LLM router, specialized agents, MCP tooling, and persistent consumer memory rather than one model doing everything.
Google Cloud's k8s-aibom auto-generates AI bills-of-materials on GKE to catch unregistered "shadow AI" workloads that evade traditional scanners.
AWS added a low-code UI on top of SageMaker's existing inference-recommendation API.
Claude Fable 5 beat Hebbia's own finance-specific models on Hebbia's financial-diligence evals — their biggest accuracy gain yet.

categories.name: Agent Runtimes, Orchestration & MCP
categories.summary: Production teams and open-source builders are converging on multi-agent architectures with explicit control layers — audited control planes, P2P coordination protocols, and memory-backed agent routing — instead of one do-everything model.

articles.title: How DoorDash Built an AI Shopping Assistant That Doesn't Rely on the LLM Alone
articles.summary: Ask DoorDash pairs an LLM router with specialized agents, MCP-based tools, and persistent consumer memory instead of leaning on a single model for everything.

articles.title: Show HN: PlanWright – A control plane for AI coding agents
articles.summary: MCP-based control plane lets you plan in Claude Desktop, implement in Codex, and review in a separate triage agent, with every decision logged for audit.

articles.title: Node0 – A P2P protocol and SDK for autonomous AI agents
articles.summary: Open P2P protocol and SDK aim to let autonomous agents discover and transact with each other directly, without a central orchestrator.

categories.name: Coding-Agent Developer Tools
categories.summary: A wave of small, focused tools is filling gaps in the coding-agent workflow: live financial data, remote browser control, visual feedback, and attention-routing across several concurrent agents.

articles.title: Show HN: Finterm.ai Bloomberg terminal for Claude Code
articles.summary: New CLI gives coding agents direct access to stock prices, options data, and SEC filings, plus a filtered "Ticker Deep Research" mode, so agents can reason over live financial data without scraping.

articles.title: Show HN: Call to Control AI Agents via the Web
articles.summary: Open-source ADE (Agentic Development Environment) client lets you drive Codex, Claude Code, or Open Code from a browser, so you can steer a coding agent away from your primary machine.

articles.title: Show HN: Baton - Know which of your AI coding agents needs you
articles.summary: Baton tracks several running coding agents at once and surfaces which one is blocked waiting on you, addressing the babysitting problem of running multiple agents in parallel.

articles.title: Show HN: Let your coding agent iterate by seeing the browser
articles.summary: peek-cli streams a live browser view into a coding agent's context so it can iterate on UI changes by seeing the rendered page, not just reading the DOM.

categories.name: Infra, Security & Data Governance
categories.summary: Cloud providers and the local-first community are both tightening what counts as real control over AI systems — one making inference configuration easier to get right, the other making unregistered AI workloads and shallow ownership claims harder to hide behind.

articles.title: Securing the AI supply chain on GKE: Introducing k8s-aibom for automated AI BOMs
articles.summary: Google Cloud's k8s-aibom automatically generates AI bills-of-materials on GKE to catch "shadow AI" workloads that developers deploy without registering them, which traditional scanners miss.

articles.title: Launching UI for generative AI inference recommendations in Amazon SageMaker AI
articles.summary: AWS added a low-code UI on top of SageMaker's existing inference-recommendation API, so teams can get instance-type and configuration recommendations for a model without calling the API directly.

articles.title: The Path to Sovereign Data: Challenges and Priorities in Local-First Computing
articles.summary: A panel on local-first computing argued that genuine data ownership requires structural independence and interoperability, not just account-level control, pushing back on how most "data ownership" claims are scoped today.

categories.name: Models & Evals
categories.summary: A general-purpose frontier model outscored a domain specialist's own tuned models on that specialist's benchmark, a notable data point for teams deciding whether to fine-tune or just use a stronger base model.

articles.title: Working at the frontier: How Hebbia builds AI for financial diligence that can't miss a detail | Claude by Anthropic
articles.summary: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 outscored Hebbia's own finance-specific models on Hebbia's financial-diligence evaluations, the biggest accuracy jump Hebbia has recorded on that benchmark.
